faq.q: What is the origin of Jonah?
faq.a: Jonah is associated with Arabic. Jonah is the English form of Arabic يُونُس (Yūnus), the Qur'anic prophet Jonah, mentioned in the Qur'an and the name of a Qur'anic sura. The source gloss 'Dove' is unsupported; the name is a proper name.
Yes — the underlying form يونس is Arabic.

faq.q: What are the variants of Jonah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Jonah, jonah. Script forms are يونس, یونس, यूनुस.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
